name: Jamerson syncopated walk
desc: James Jamerson school bass in Ab major: root anchors the one then dances - syncopated 16th pickups, chromatic approach runs into every change, open-string style drops. Round triangle tone with shape drive so it reads on small speakers.

code.full: note("<[ab1 ~ ab1 ab2 ~ ab1 g1 ab1] [f1 ~ f1 c2 ~ f1 e1 f1] [bb1 ~ bb1 f2 ~ bb1 a1 bb1] [eb1 ~ eb2 d2 db2 c2 bb1 eb1]>").add(note(${root})).s("triangle").lpf(${tone}).attack(.006).decay(.22).sustain(.25).release(.06).shape(.5).gain(${gain}).room(.08).every(8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.8)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[ab1 ab1 ~ ab2 ab1 ~ g1 ab1 ~ ab1 c2 ~ eb2 ~ g1 ab1] [f1 f1 ~ c2 f1 ~ e1 f1 ~ f1 ab1 ~ c2 ~ e1 f1] [bb1 bb1 ~ f2 bb1 ~ a1 bb1 ~ bb1 db2 ~ f2 ~ a1 bb1] [eb1 eb1 ~ eb2 d2 ~ db2 c2 ~ bb1 g1 ~ ab1 bb1 c2 d2]>").add(note(${root})).s("triangle").lpf(${tone}*1.3).attack(.005).decay(.18).sustain(.2).release(.05).shape(.55).gain(${gain}).room(.08).orbit(3).play()
